inv.text: Koilos is the cave site where Urza and Barrin bring out the metathran generals Thaddeus and Agnate, beginning a stalemated siege against Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexians.
Tsabo Tavoc lures Thaddeus into a trap and has him vivisected, so Eladamri takes his place as commander, and Agnate finds Thaddeus reduced to a ribcage and head and ends his suffering at his wish.
At Koilos Tsabo mind-controls Gerrard through his grief, but Karn gives up his pacifism and Gerrard breaks free, and together they grievously wound Tsabo, who flees through the portal.
Coalition forces capture the Koilos caves and destroy the Phyrexian portal with the Nine Titans.

tsb.text: Koilos is a cave dug out by the Brotherhood of Gix, who find their master's severed hand there and enshrine it.
